The Chief Security Officer will lead and be accountable for the overall security operations of the company across all factory units and the corporate office. The role protects our people, goods, materials, premises and reputation. The CSO will set the security policy, control the movement of goods and people in and out of every location, investigate losses and incidents, and make sure all mandatory security, safety and statutory requirements are met. The ideal candidate is a disciplined, ethical and approachable leader with a manufacturing background, who can work firmly with all levels of employees, contractors and authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Security Strategy and Policy**

* Define, document and implement the company-wide security policy and standard operating procedures for all factories and the corporate office.
* Carry out periodic risk assessments of every location and prepare a security improvement plan with budget.
* Set uniform security standards across units, and audit each unit against them.

**2. Goods and Material Movement Control**

* Monitor and control all inward and outward movement of raw materials, fabric, trims, work-in-progress, finished goods, scrap and waste.
* Ensure no vehicle enters or leaves without proper documents (gate pass, invoice, e-way bill, delivery challan) and matching of goods with documents at the gate.
* Implement vehicle checks, seal control, weighbridge verification and loading/unloading supervision.
* Work with Stores, Dispatch and Accounts to reconcile stock movement, and investigate shortages, pilferage and mismatches.
* Control movement of samples, designs, patterns and labelled or branded materials to prevent leakage and unauthorized use.

**3. People Access and Employee Monitoring**

* Manage entry and exit controls for employees, contract workers, visitors, vendors and drivers through ID cards, passes and registers or biometric/digital systems.
* Monitor attendance-related gate discipline, unauthorized movement, prohibited items, and conduct violations, and report to HR.
* Carry out random and scheduled checks of persons and belongings in a respectful, lawful manner and in line with company policy.
* Support HR in verification of new employees and contract workers, and in preventing proxy attendance and unauthorized entry.
* Ensure that monitoring is lawful, proportionate and respects employee dignity and privacy, including compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

**4. Surveillance and Technology**

* Plan, oversee and review CCTV, access control, alarm and other surveillance systems at all locations, including coverage, recording, retention and backup.
* Ensure cameras are not placed in changing rooms, restrooms or other private areas, and that footage is accessed only by authorized persons.
* Coordinate with the IT team on integration of security systems with the company network and on protecting security data.

**5. Investigation and Loss Prevention**

* Investigate theft, pilferage, fraud, collusion, misconduct and security incidents, and prepare written reports with findings and recommendations.
* Conduct surprise audits and checks, and maintain an incident register with root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Work with HR, Legal and Management on disciplinary action, and with police and law-enforcement authorities where needed.

* Work with the Safety and HR teams on fire safety, evacuation plans, mock drills, first-aid readiness and emergency contact systems at every unit.

* Support workplace safety for women employees, including coordination with the POSH Internal Committee and safe transport and campus movement practices.

* Recruit, train, deploy, supervise and appraise the in-house security team and outsourced guards.
* Select and manage the security agency, ensuring it holds valid licenses (PSARA) and complies with wages, PF, ESI and other statutory requirements.
* Set duty rosters, post orders and patrol routes, and review performance through regular inspections.

**8. Statutory Compliance and Reporting**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and licences relating to security, fire safety, factory premises, security agencies and the storage of materials.
* Maintain statutory and internal records, registers and audit-ready documentation.
* Submit weekly and monthly security reports to the Managing Director covering incidents, losses, audits, compliance status and improvement actions.

**Company Description**
Telephysio Wellness Center is a growing physiotherapy practice focused on providing evidence-based, patient-centered care. Located in The Nilgiris, the center serves a diverse community with a range of musculoskeletal, neurological, and rehabilitative needs. The team is committed to improving functional outcomes and quality of life through personalized treatment plans and consistent follow-up. **Role Description**

The Physiotherapist will assess patients’ physical conditions, take detailed histories, and develop individualized treatment plans using appropriate therapeutic exercises and modalities. The Physiotherapist will collaborate with other healthcare professionals when required, maintain high standards of hygiene and safety in the treatment area, and participate in clinical meetings and continuing education activities.
  
**Qualifications**

* Recognized degree in Physiotherapy (BPT or higher), valid professional registration or license as applicable, and adherence to clinical and ethical standards.
* Proficiency in patient assessment, treatment planning, and delivery of evidence-based physiotherapy interventions across musculoskeletal, neurological, and rehabilitative care.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to explain treatment plans clearly, build trust with patients and caregivers, and work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Ability to maintain accurate clinical documentation, manage time efficiently in a busy practice, and use basic digital tools for scheduling and record-keeping.
* Commitment to ongoing professional development, openness to feedback, and willingness to participate in training, case discussions, and quality improvement initiatives.
* Prior experience in a clinical physiotherapy setting is beneficial; familiarity with community or rural healthcare environments in regions like The Nilgiris is an added advantage.

title: Graduate Engineering Trainee (GET) - Quality
description:
About the Role
 
 We are looking for a 
 **Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Quality** 
  to join our Quality team in transformer manufacturing. The candidate will be trained and involved in 
 **quality inspection, testing, documentation, process monitoring and quality assurance** 
  throughout the transformer manufacturing process.
 



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for a fresh engineering graduate to build strong practical knowledge in 
 **distribution and power transformers, electrical testing, manufacturing processes and Quality Management Systems (QMS).** 




  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Assist the Quality team in 
 **incoming, in\-process and final inspection** 
  of transformer components and assemblies.
* Support inspection of 
 **core, winding, insulation, tank, accessories and other transformer components** 
  as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Assist in conducting and recording 
 **routine and type tests** 
  as applicable.
* Learn and support transformer testing activities such as:
* Winding Resistance
* Transformer Ratio / Voltage Ratio
* Insulation Resistance
* No\-Load Loss \& Current
* Load Loss \& Impedance
* Dielectric / Applied Voltage Test
* Induced Voltage Test
* Oil\-related tests and other applicable inspections
* Verify manufacturing activities against 
 **approved drawings, specifications, work instructions and quality standards** 
 .
* Maintain accurate 
 **inspection reports, test reports, checklists and quality records** 
 .
* Assist in identifying 
 **non\-conformities, defects and process deviations** 
  and support root\-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with 
 **Production, Design, Purchase and Stores** 
  teams for resolution of quality\-related issues.
* Support preparation of 
 **NCR, CAPA and corrective/preventive action records** 
 .
* Assist in maintaining and implementing the company's 
 **ISO 9001 Quality Management System** 
 .
* Participate in internal quality audits, process audits and customer inspections.
* Ensure proper calibration and identification of 
 **measuring and testing instruments** 
 .
* Assist in maintaining quality documentation and records as per QMS requirements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to reduce 
 **rework, rejection and manufacturing defects** 
 .
* Follow all applicable 
 **safety, quality and manufacturing procedures** 
 .



  




 Technical Exposure
 
 The candidate will receive hands\-on exposure to:
 


* Distribution \& Power Transformers
* Transformer manufacturing processes
* Electrical \& mechanical inspection
* Transformer testing procedures
* Quality Control \& Quality Assurance
* **IS 1180, IS 2026 and IEC 60076**
* **Electrical drawings and specifications**
* **ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System**
* **NCR, CAPA and Root Cause Analysis**
* **Calibration and measuring instruments**
* **Customer and third\-party inspections**



  




 Candidate Profile
 * **Qualification:** 
  B.E./B.Tech in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering / Electrical Engineering
* **Experience:** 
  Freshers / 0–1 year experience
* Strong interest in 
 **Quality, Testing and Manufacturing**
* **Basic knowledge of electrical engineering concepts**
* **Ability to understand technical drawings and specifications**
* **Good analytical and problem\-solving skills**
* **Good communication and documentation skills**
* **Willingness to work on the shop floor and testing areas**
* **Positive attitude with a strong willingness to learn**



**﻿**



 What We Offer
 * Hands\-on training in 
 **transformer manufacturing and testing**
* **Exposure to industry standards and quality systems**
* **Opportunity to work with experienced Quality, Design and Production teams**
* **Practical exposure to customer and third\-party inspections**
* **Career growth opportunities in Quality Assurance, Quality Control and Testing**
* **Ideal for:** 
  Fresh engineering graduates who want to build a career in 
 **Transformer Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Electrical Testing and Industrial Quality Management.**
